name: Rubix Foods
old_description: The NEXT Flavor Report is a first-of-its-kind compilation of third-party market research and proprietary data gathered by the Rubix Foods NEXT Flavor Network – a collective of influential taste-making social media creators with Gen Z audiences – who have helped us unveil the unfiltered, unbiased and real-time cravings of this highly sought after generation who will reshape the flavor trends and strategies of restaurant menus in 2025.
about:
Rubix Foods traces its roots to Jacksonville, Florida, where Aaron Block and Aaron Lapin co-founded Reddi-Wip in 1948. The business evolved through the Block family for five generations, with Mickey Block building the first U.S. ultra-high-temperature dairy plant in 1965. Darifair Foods was established in 1981 as the first national dairy supplier, becoming the nation’s largest producer of portion-controlled private-label sour cream by the 1990s. In 2021 the company rebranded as Rubix Foods, expanding beyond dairy into end-to-end product development under continued family ownership.

Today Rubix operates as a full-service product development house with end-to-end manufacturing capabilities. Its 50,000-square-foot Innovation Center, opened in 2022 and FDA-registered in 2024, houses R&D, culinary, and production under one roof. Core platforms include compound butter systems, sauces and glazes, dips/spreads/fillings, performance blends, marination systems, aerosol systems, cultured dairy (sour creams, yogurts), and dairy essentials such as milk, buttermilk, and cream. The facility supports custom formulation from concept through commercialization.

The company serves foodservice chains and high-momentum brands, providing private-label and co-manufactured products for national accounts. Historical customers include leading quick-service and casual-dining operators that rely on Rubix for portion-controlled sour cream, clean-label cream alternatives, and custom marination blends for proteins and vegetables.

Rubix positions itself on speed, quality, and reliability, aiming to be the industry’s first call for solving tough formulation challenges. Its NEXT Flavor Network leverages Gen Z social-media creators to deliver real-time consumer insights, while a disciplined “velocity to market” approach compresses development timelines without sacrificing execution.
